title: "WHACK HIM AGAIN": Everyone Is Saying The Same Thing About AOC's Response To Ted Cruz's Attempt To Shade Her - NewsBreak
text:
By Bella Arnold ,
5 hours ago
Ted Cruz seems to have this habit of getting himself into precarious situations. Pickles, if you will. Tom Williams / CQ-Roll Call, Inc via Getty Images Like leaving Texas — the state he serves as a senator — for Cancún, Mexico, during a historic ice storm . MEGA / GC Images Then doing it again. Going to Laguna Beach , California, just as another winter storm was gearing up to hit Texas this past January. @shea_jordan / Via Twitter: @shea_jordan And trying to joke about the backlash... @tedcruz / Via x.com Related: Stephen Colbert Just Spotted Rock-Solid Proof Trump's Life "Isn't Going Great" Right Now, And It's Something Everyone Needs To See
He also tried to subtweet Zohran Mamdani , which seems like an obvious bad choice. Just categorically unwise. @thig265 / Via Twitter: @thig265 Now, he's trying to talk badly about Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for...being a bartender. Drew Angerer / Getty Images Big mistake. Big! HUGE! MANDEL NGAN / AFP via Getty Images Recently, AOC made comments about the American Revolution, arguing that the movement was " against the billionaires of their time ." Which, seemingly, had Mr. Cruz feeling some type of way. Valerie Plesch / Bloomberg via Getty Images He talked to his buddy Sean Hannity about it, saying, "It was American free enterprise capitalists who invested in seeking freedom, and, by the way, AOC also said it is impossible for anyone to earn a billion dollars." (Note: AOC did not say it was impossible for anyone to make a billion dollars. She said it was impossible to earn a billion dollars without others suffering as a result.)
Fox News / Via youtube.com Cruz continued, saying, "Which, look, I recognize for her, given that she was a bartender, that is probably true." Fox News / Via youtube.com "And there's no disrespect to bartenders. Bartenders are an honorable profession. But she went from that to being a government employee and a parasite sucking on the taxpayer," he said. Here's the full clip.
Fox News / Via youtube.com Related: 21 Terrifying, Shocking, And Extremely Disturbing Things I Learned Last Month
KA ! Syco Entertainment / Via giphy.com For context, AOC has spoken at length about her time as a bartender before, when, at 29, she became the youngest woman and Latina elected to Congress. After her father's sudden passing and the 2008 financial crisis, Ocasio-Cortez says she "pulled extra shifts" to "support her family." Drew Angerer / Getty Images Obviously, people were quick to point out that, by his definition, Cruz, who is also a government employee, is a "parasite sucking on the taxpayer," too. "Who wants to tell him?" one tweet reads. "So AOC is a government employee and a paracite suck off the taxpayers.. How long has Ted Cruz been in government again? Has he ever done anything other than grandstand on Fox News and run to Cancun?" @imposter_edits / Via Twitter: @Imposter_Edits "Ted Cruz just called himself a parasite sucking on the taxpayer." Related: Donald Trump Just Said The 1 Thing A President Should Never Joke About, And Critics Are Alarmed
A reporter asked AOC about Cruz's comments, and her response was very, very direct. Graeme Sloan / Getty Images "It's not a secret. The disdain that Ted Cruz has for people who work working-class jobs," she started. Graeme Sloan / Getty Images The 36-year-old congressperson continued, "It's not a secret...what he thinks of the waitresses, the line cooks. He thinks that we're less than him." Graeme Sloan / Getty Images "He thinks that because he has a Harvard degree and never scrubbed a table that that makes him better than someone who's actually had to work for a living," she added. Graeme Sloan / Getty Images "I think it's funny that he's been taking a government paycheck for 23 years, but has the audacity to criticize someone who has come from a family that had to work their way up and earn their place here. And, you know, if that's how he feels, that's how he feels. I don't take it personally," she finished. Graeme Sloan / Getty Images The only way I can describe the response online is BOOM! BLAMO! WHAM! You can watch the full clip here .
Graeme Sloan / Getty Images "WHACK HIM AGAIN," one user posted. "She absolutely bodied him. Somewhere Cruz’s daughter is quietly liking the clip." Related: This Fox News Host Just Made A Great Point About Trump's New Ballroom
"Cruz is a loser and I’m glad she’s just breezing past his bullshit with intelligence, class, and poise." X / Via x.com "She’s so good." "Someone get a body bag for @tedcruz." "TATTOO IT ON MY FUCKING SKULL." And, finally: "In case anyone hasn’t done this in a while, I just wanted to say fuck you @tedcruz." There ya have it! Thoughts???
